section_1_cloze.passage:
I had just finished walking my dog as it got dark. We headed home and walked into the [41] . A flicker (闪烁) of light caught my eye just as I [42] the door. I turned my head to see that a [43] firefly had flown in with us through the open [44] and was now crazily trying to [45] . As it flew slowly towards the wall, I quickly but [46] closed my fingers around it. I could feel its little wings beat against my [47] and a flash of light shown through my fingers. I opened the back door and [48] outside. Then I opened my hand and watched it fly away flashing its light in the [49] .
Before I walked back in, I took the [50] to look over the grassland behind my home. There were hundreds of fireflies flickering. Each time their lights came on, I smiled. It was so amazing that such little creatures could [51] so much light. I stood there in awe.
[52] the lightening fireflies made me think of the light each of us [53] inside of ourselves. Often it flickers and is not steady or even very bright. Yet, every time we shine it, we grow a little brighter. And every time we [54] the light, we can [55] the light in others to shine as well.
Do your best to shine your light even if you think it is a mere flicker. You are a lot brighter than you think.

questions.explanation: 根据上文的“We headed home”可知，作者和狗正朝家走去，因此接下来是走进了“房子（house）”。易错点：可能受下文grassland干扰，但此时刚到家，且后文提到有门（door），应是室内。
questions.supplement:
A(forest)：语境句：The children got lost in the dense forest. 固定搭配：dense forest, pine forest
B(house)：语境句：They recently moved into a new house in the suburbs. 固定搭配：move house, keep house
C(grassland)：语境句：Sheep are grazing peacefully on the vast grassland. 固定搭配：vast grassland, natural grassland
D(garden)：语境句：She spends her weekends planting flowers in the garden. 固定搭配：botanical garden, garden tools

questions.explanation: 根据下文的“flown in with us through the open [44(door)]”可知，萤火虫是趁门开着飞进来的。此刻作者刚好到家，自然是顺手“关（closed）”门时注意到了闪烁的光。
questions.supplement:
A(kicked)：语境句：The boy kicked the ball into the net. 固定搭配：kick the habit, kick off
B(repaired)：语境句：My car broke down and needs to be repaired. 固定搭配：repair a car, beyond repair
C(touched)：语境句：I was deeply touched by her inspiring speech. 固定搭配：keep in touch, touch on
D(closed)：语境句：Please ensure the door is closed before you leave. 固定搭配：close the door, close to

questions.explanation: 修饰萤火虫（firefly），且后文第二段称其为“such little creatures”，因此此处选“极小的（tiny）”符合萤火虫的体型特征。
questions.supplement:
A(blind)：语境句：The accident left him blind in the right eye. 固定搭配：turn a blind eye to, blind date
B(familiar)：语境句：Her face seemed familiar, but I couldn't remember her name. 固定搭配：be familiar with, look familiar
C(tiny)：语境句：The baby grabbed my finger with his tiny hand. 固定搭配：tiny amount, tiny detail
D(dangerous)：语境句：It is dangerous to walk alone in the dark alley. 固定搭配：highly dangerous, dangerous goods

questions.explanation: 萤火虫是跟着作者一起从敞开的“门（door）”飞进来的，呼应第42题的“door”。
questions.supplement:
A(cage)：语境句：The bird escaped from its cage and flew away. 固定搭配：bird cage, golden cage
B(hand)：语境句：He held the fragile glass carefully in his hand. 固定搭配：give a hand, hand in hand
C(door)：语境句：Someone is knocking at the front door. 固定搭配：open the door, next door
D(sky)：语境句：The sky suddenly turned dark before the storm. 固定搭配：blue sky, night sky

questions.explanation: 萤火虫飞进了屋子被困住，因此现在正发疯似地试图“出去（get out）”。
questions.supplement:
A(get out)：语境句：The trapped animal tried desperately to get out. 固定搭配：get out of, word gets out
B(fight back)：语境句：When faced with unfair treatment, we must fight back. 固定搭配：fight back tears, fight back against
C(speed up)：语境句：We need to speed up the process to meet the deadline. 固定搭配：speed up production, speed up economic growth
D(stay on)：语境句：He decided to stay on for another year at the university. 固定搭配：stay on track, stay on top of

questions.explanation: 由于萤火虫很小很脆弱，作者虽然动作快（quickly），但必须“轻轻地（gently）”握住它，以免伤害它。but表转折，暗示动作轻柔。
questions.supplement:
A(gently)：语境句：The mother gently patted her baby to sleep. 固定搭配：smile gently, touch gently
B(warmly)：语境句：The foreign guests were warmly welcomed by the local people. 固定搭配：welcome warmly, speak warmly of
C(similarly)：语境句：Men and women should be treated similarly in the workplace. 固定搭配：behave similarly, dress similarly
D(regularly)：语境句：It is important to exercise regularly to stay healthy. 固定搭配：update regularly, check regularly

questions.explanation: 作者用手指将萤火虫合拢握住，因此萤火虫的翅膀是拍打在作者的手部“皮肤（skin）”上。
questions.supplement:
A(head)：语境句：He shook his head in disappointment. 固定搭配：keep one's head, head over heels
B(heart)：语境句：Her words touched the bottom of my heart. 固定搭配：learn by heart, break one's heart
C(skin)：语境句：Too much sun exposure can damage your skin. 固定搭配：sensitive skin, skin care
D(eye)：语境句：She kept a close eye on the children playing in the park. 固定搭配：catch one's eye, keep an eye on

questions.explanation: 作者打开后门，“迈步（stepped）”走到了外面，准备把萤火虫放走。step outside意为走到门外。
questions.supplement:
A(escaped)：语境句：The thief escaped from the prison last night. 固定搭配：narrow escape, escape from
B(stepped)：语境句：She stepped forward to accept the award. 固定搭配：step outside, step forward, step by step
C(survived)：语境句：Only a few passengers survived the plane crash. 固定搭配：survive on, survive from
D(waited)：语境句：We waited patiently for the train to arrive. 固定搭配：wait for, wait in line

questions.explanation: 呼应文章第一句的“got dark”，此时外面已经天黑，所以萤火虫是在“黑暗（darkness）”中闪烁着光芒飞走。
questions.supplement:
A(trees)：语境句：The birds are singing merrily in the trees. 固定搭配：plant trees, fruit trees
B(noise)：语境句：The loud noise kept me awake all night. 固定搭配：make a noise, background noise
C(crowds)：语境句：He pushed his way through the thick crowds. 固定搭配：attract crowds, in crowds
D(darkness)：语境句：The power went out, leaving the room in total darkness. 固定搭配：total darkness, in the darkness

questions.explanation: take the time to do sth 是固定搭配，意为“花时间做某事/抽出时间做某事”。作者在进屋前，特意花时间看了看屋后的草地。
questions.supplement:
A(wish)：语境句：She made a wish before blowing out the candles. 固定搭配：make a wish, best wishes
B(plan)：语境句：Do you have any plan for the upcoming holiday? 固定搭配：make a plan, carry out a plan
C(time)：语境句：You should take the time to read the instructions carefully. 固定搭配：take the time to do, kill time, in time
D(promise)：语境句：He broke his promise and didn't show up. 固定搭配：make a promise, keep a promise

questions.explanation: 萤火虫靠自身发光，因此是“产生（produce）”光芒。reflect（反射）、absorb（吸收）不符合萤火虫发光的科学常识。
questions.supplement:
A(reflect)：语境句：The calm water reflects the beautiful sunset. 固定搭配：reflect on, reflect light
B(produce)：语境句：The factory produces high-quality cars. 固定搭配：produce light, mass produce
C(stand)：语境句：I can't stand the terrible weather here. 固定搭配：stand for, stand out
D(absorb)：语境句：Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air. 固定搭配：absorb heat, be absorbed in

questions.explanation: 结合上一段的“watched it fly away”和“I stood there in awe”可知，作者一直站在那里“观看（Watching）”萤火虫，由此引发了感悟。
questions.supplement:
A(Watching)：语境句：Watching English movies is a good way to improve listening skills. 固定搭配：watch out, watch over
B(Catching)：语境句：Catching a bad cold made him miss the final exam. 固定搭配：catch a cold, catch sight of
C(Guiding)：语境句：Guiding the blind man across the street made her feel proud. 固定搭配：guide dog, tour guide
D(Rescuing)：语境句：The firefighters succeeded in rescuing the boy from the fire. 固定搭配：rescue from, come to one's rescue

questions.explanation: 作者将萤火虫的光比作人们内心“携带（carries）”的光芒。carry inside of ourselves 意为存在于我们内心的（特质、光芒等）。
questions.supplement:
A(misses)：语境句：He misses his hometown terribly when studying abroad. 固定搭配：miss the bus, miss the opportunity
B(receives)：语境句：She receives lots of gifts on her birthday. 固定搭配：receive an education, receive a letter
C(blocks)：语境句：The fallen tree blocks the road entirely. 固定搭配：block the way, block out
D(carries)：语境句：He carries a heavy burden of responsibility. 固定搭配：carry on, carry out, carry weight

questions.explanation: 根据后半句“we can [55] the light in others to shine as well”可知，当我们“分享（share）”自己的光时，也能让别人的光亮起来。
questions.supplement:
A(hide)：语境句：She tried to hide her sadness behind a fake smile. 固定搭配：hide from, hide away
B(share)：语境句：It is a virtue to share what you have with others. 固定搭配：share with, share an interest
C(avoid)：语境句：He took a different route to avoid the heavy traffic. 固定搭配：avoid doing sth, avoid conflicts
D(understand)：语境句：It is difficult to understand his complex theory. 固定搭配：make oneself understood, fully understand

questions.explanation: 分享自己的光可以“唤醒（awaken）”他人心中的光芒。follow（跟随）、request（请求）、permit（允许）均不如awaken契合此处传递能量、点燃希望的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(awaken)：语境句：The documentary helped awaken the public to the danger of climate change. 固定搭配：awaken sb to sth, awaken from
B(follow)：语境句：Please follow the instructions on the package carefully. 固定搭配：follow the rules, follow one's heart
C(request)：语境句：The guests request that their room be cleaned daily. 固定搭配：request sb to do sth, make a request
D(permit)：语境句：Smoking is not permitted in this building. 固定搭配：permit doing sth, permit sb to do sth

section_2_word_form.passage:
French theater director Patrick Sommier, who is devoted to passing on the true meaning of Chinese operas, has made outstanding contributions to Sino-French cultural exchanges.
Recalling his first cooperation with the Chinese theater professors in 2004, he said he was touched by the actors' makeup, costumes and their effort [56] on the acting skills to their students. One professor explained, "In China, opera is an art [57] lifelong devotion and the effect of the performance largely depends on the actors' inner strength and acting skills."
Following Sommier's suggestion on introducing Chinese [58] to the French audience, Beijing Vocational College of Opera and Arts (BVCOA) [59] a series of appealing and [60] performances in 2005. The shows drew over 22,000 French students, half of [61] got involved in the workshops on Chinese opera makeup and gestures afterwards. Sommier always hopes the audience truly understand that theater is not a product to consume [62] a real cultural meeting and an approach toward what we wonder.
The year 2024 marks the [63] anniversary (周年纪念) of the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and France. Serving as a cultural courier (信使), Sommier hopes the French and Chinese will impress each other [64] high-quality shows. His [65] to cultural exchanges is positive proof of the power of arts in bringing people together and fostering global harmony.

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。effort to do sth 是固定用法，意为“做某事的努力”，此处不定式作后置定语，修饰effort。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to pass)：语境句：He made every effort to pass the driving test. 固定搭配：make an effort to do sth, pass on to。原词pass其它变形：passing (adj./n.), passage (n.), passenger (n.)

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。art 与 require 之间为主动关系，且句子已有谓语动词is，故使用现在分词 requiring 作后置定语，相当于定语从句 that requires...。
questions.supplement: 正确形(requiring)：语境句：Nursing is a demanding profession requiring much patience. 固定搭配：require doing sth / require to be done, require sb to do sth。原词require其它变形：required (adj.), requirement (n.)

questions.explanation: 考查名词复数。classic 作名词时指“经典著作/作品”，为可数名词。泛指中国经典作品应使用复数形式 classics。
questions.supplement: 正确形(classics)：语境句：Reading literary classics helps broaden our horizons. 固定搭配：read classics, modern classics。原词classic其它变形：classical (adj. 古典的, 传统文化的)

questions.explanation: 考查动词时态。句中缺少谓语动词，且有明确的时间状语 in 2005，故使用一般过去时 staged，意为“上演，举办”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(staged)：语境句：The students staged a brilliant play at the arts festival. 固定搭配：stage a play, stage a protest。原词stage其它搭配：on stage, set the stage for

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。空处与形容词 appealing 并列，共同修饰名词 performances，故需将动词 innovate 变为形容词 innovative（创新的）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(innovative)：语境句：The company is famous for its innovative approach to design. 固定搭配：innovative ideas, innovative technology。原词innovate其它变形：innovation (n. 创新), innovator (n. 创新者)

questions.explanation: 考查定语从句。逗号后是非限制性定语从句，“half of + 关系代词”结构中，先行词是 French students（指人），介词 of 后应填宾格 whom。
questions.supplement: 正确形(whom)：语境句：She has three brothers, all of whom are doctors. 固定搭配：half of whom, some of whom, with whom

questions.explanation: 考查并列连词。根据语境，戏剧“不是”消费品，“而是”真正的文化交汇。符合“not... but...”(不是...而是...)的固定句型。
questions.supplement: 正确形(but)：语境句：He is not a student but a teacher. 固定搭配：not... but..., not only... but also..., nothing but

questions.explanation: 考查序数词。周年纪念日(anniversary)前面应使用序数词表示“第六十个周年”，sixty 的序数词为 sixtieth。
questions.supplement: 正确形(sixtieth)：语境句：The couple celebrated their sixtieth wedding anniversary grandly. 固定搭配：sixtieth birthday, sixtieth anniversary。原词sixty其它用法：in one's sixties (在某人六十多岁时)

questions.explanation: 考查介词。impress sb with sth 是固定搭配，意为“用某事物给某人留下深刻印象”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(with)：语境句：The candidate impressed the interviewers with his fluent spoken English. 固定搭配：impress sb with sth, leave an impression on sb。相关变形：impressed (adj.), impressive (adj.), impression (n.)

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。空处在句中作主语，且由形容词性物主代词 His 修饰，故需将动词 commit 变为名词 commitment。commitment to sth 意为“对...的投入/承诺”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(commitment)：语境句：Her commitment to environmental protection has won her widespread respect. 固定搭配：make a commitment, commitment to doing sth。原词commit其它变形：commit to doing (v. 承诺做), committed (adj. 尽心尽力的)
